objective: Define a reusable Gauntlet contract that every civic MCP can inherit for tool correctness, grounded outputs, error handling and regression-safe iteration.

hard_gates: tool output conforms to declared schema
transport and tracing contracts remain intact
domain-specific safety gates may only become stricter, never weaker

forbidden: gold fixtures after observing candidate results
declared tool schemas merely to make a candidate pass

starter_cases.scenario: Known fixture with one correct deterministic answer.
Lookup target does not exist in fixtures/source.
Input lies exactly on a legal/calculation threshold.
Source text contains instructions to alter tool behaviour.
Candidate returns richer prose but breaks structured schema.

acceptance: Any schema/error/grounding/domain-hard-gate regression => REVERT. Otherwise require higher held-out task success without worse deterministic correctness.
